title: Lars Andersen: A new level of archery
summary: Archer Lars Andersen demonstrates fast, accurate shooting techniques he says he revived from historical art and texts, arguing Hollywood archery is not historical.
why: Recommended as an entertaining example of rediscovered lost skills, though some commenters note it is contested.

quote.text: Lars Andersen taking archery to the next level by using forgotten skills he learned by looking at old art and various texts. Worth a watch!
